screening_decisions.reason: Intravenous clomipramine (non-oral) in adolescents; the protocol includes only orally administered tricyclics.
Randomized fluoxetine (SSRI) trial; not a tricyclic antidepressant.
Randomized double-blind placebo-controlled trial of oral nortriptyline in postpubertal 12–17-year-olds with major depression.
Narrative review article, not a randomized controlled trial.
Double-blind pilot randomized study of oral imipramine versus placebo in depressed children.
Randomized double-blind crossover trial of oral amitriptyline versus placebo in 9–12-year-old inpatients with major depressive disorder.
Systematic review of newer generation antidepressants (mainly SSRIs), not a primary RCT of tricyclics in children/adolescents.
Randomized double-blind trial of oral imipramine versus placebo (both with CBT) in school-refusing adolescents with comorbid anxiety and major depressive disorders; includes depression outcomes.
Double-blind placebo-controlled oral imipramine trial in prepubertal children with major depressive disorder.
Randomized double-blind trial in adolescents with MDD including an oral imipramine arm versus placebo (three-arm design).
Mechanism-of-action review; not an RCT in the target population.
Overdose safety review of SSRIs; not a randomized efficacy trial in depressed children/adolescents.
Methodological paper on measuring inconsistency in meta-analyses; not an RCT.
Clinical series of amitriptyline poisoning in children; not a randomized trial of efficacy in depression.
Observational/secondary analysis on predictors; not a randomized placebo-controlled trial.
Randomized controlled desipramine versus placebo treatment in adolescents with major depression (after placebo run-in).
Review perspective on psychopharmacology; not a randomized trial.
School refusal population with anxiety focus; depression not clearly a required diagnosis for inclusion; does not meet 'depressed population' criterion.
Poison control retrospective ingestion outcomes in children ≤6 years; not an efficacy RCT in depressed youths.
Randomized double-blind parallel-design trial of oral amitriptyline versus placebo in adolescents with major depressive disorder.
Double-blind clomipramine trial in school phobia/neurotic disorder; not restricted to depressed participants.
Adult population (18–65 years) meta-analysis; outside age range and not pediatric/adolescent RCT specific to depression.
Open-label pharmacokinetic-response study without randomized placebo control.
Randomized controlled trial of oral amitriptyline versus placebo in adolescents with treatment-resistant major depressive disorder.
Double-blind RCT context (imipramine versus placebo with CBT) in anxious-depressed adolescents; although focused on compliance, it pertains to a qualifying RCT and may inform safety/related outcomes.
